title: Future Juice Lemon Butter Cookie  Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Lemon Butter Cookie is a rich, bakery-inspired blend that pairs zesty Lemon with the comforting sweetness of a golden Butter Cookie. The citrusy brightness of Lemon cuts through the buttery richness, creating a delicate balance of tangy and sweet. The Cookie base delivers warm, crumbly notes with a hint of vanilla, rounding off the flavour with a comforting, freshly baked finish. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense clouds and deep flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it offers a satisfying all-day vape with a rich dessert profile. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
